test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Akshay places three identical rings of diameter 21 cm in such a manner that each one touches the other two rings. He observes that there is a space enclosed by the circles. What is the area (in cm²) of this portion? (Take π = (22)/(7))

Note — Rounded off to nearest 2 decimal places and √3 = 1.732
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area enclosed by three equal circles touching each other = r²(√3 − π/2) where r = 21 ÷ 2 = 10.5 cm.

Enclosed Area = (10.5)² × (1.732 − 11/7)

Enclosed Area = (110.25 × 1.732) − (110.25 × 11 ÷ 7)

Enclosed Area = 190.953 − 173.25 = 17.703 ≈ 17.70 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 17.70 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79c8a37e1c3c62643bdba3fb3ecfb4e0f4dc9a71b25fc97c5f35d35bf5ab4307.png] 

**Given:**

Diameter of each ring = 21 cm

Radius (r) = 21 ÷ 2 = 10.5 cm

**Concept Used:**

When three identical circles touch each other externally, their centers form an equilateral triangle with side length equal to 2r.

Area of enclosed space = Area of Equilateral Triangle − Area of 3 Sectors enclosed inside the triangle

**Calculations:**

⇒ Side of the equilateral triangle (a) = r + r = 10.5 + 10.5 = 21 cm

⇒ Area of equilateral triangle = (√3 ÷ 4) × a²

⇒ Area of equilateral triangle = (1.732 ÷ 4) × 21²

⇒ Area of equilateral triangle = 0.433 × 441 = 190.953 cm²

⇒ The equilateral triangle has three interior angles of 60°, so the three sectors combined form a semi-circle (180°).

⇒ Area of the 3 sectors = (1 ÷ 2) × π × r²

⇒ Area of the 3 sectors = (1 ÷ 2) × (22 ÷ 7) × (10.5)²

⇒ Area of the 3 sectors = 11 × 1.5 × 10.5 = 173.25 cm²

⇒ Area of enclosed space = 190.953 − 173.25 = 17.703 cm²

⇒ Rounding off to nearest 2 decimal places, we get 17.70 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 17.70 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Enclosed Space Between Three Circles

When three equal circles of radius r touch each other externally, the area of the enclosed space is mathematically given as r²(√3 − π/2).

Perimeter of the Enclosed Space

The boundary of the enclosed space is formed by three inward arcs of 60° each. Its total perimeter is equal to the circumference of a semi-circle, which is πr.

Radius of Inscribed Circle

The radius of the largest possible circle that can be inscribed exactly in the empty space between three touching identical circles is r((2 ÷ √3) − 1).
</p
